Pogorzałe Ługi. Pogorzałe Ługi [pɔɡɔˈʐawɛ ˈwuɡi] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Rokiciny within Tomaszów Mazowiecki County Łódź Voivodeship in central Poland. Narivaran-e Gharbi. Narivaran-e Gharbi ( Persian: ناريوران غربي‎ also Romanized as Nārīvarān-e Gharbī; also known as Nārīvarān ) is a village in Sajjadrud Rural District Bandpey-ye Sharqi District Babol County Mazandaran Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 390 in 96 families.

Orchów. Orchów [ˈɔrxuf] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Łask within Łask County Łódź Voivodeship in central Poland. It lies approximately 4 kilometres ( 2 mi ) north of Łask and 31 km ( 19 mi ) south-west of the regional capital Łódź.

Zaczopki. Zaczopki [zaˈt͡ʂɔpkʲi] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Rokitno within Biała Podlaska County Lublin Voivodeship in eastern Poland close to the border with Belarus. Takht-e Sabz. Takht-e Sabz ( Persian: تخت سبز‎; also known as Takht-e Sabz-e Vosţá and Takht-e Sar ) is a village in Pian Rural District in the Central District of Izeh County Khuzestan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 120 in 17 families.

Mazraeh-ye Mallu. Mazraeh-ye Mallu ( Persian: مزرعه ملو‎ also Romanized as Mazra‘eh-ye Mallū; also known as Mallū ) is a village in Khuzi Rural District Varavi District Mohr County Fars Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 36 in 6 families.

Beyt-e Ashur. Beyt-e Ashur ( Persian: بيت عاشور‎ also Romanized as Beyt-e ‘Āshūr; also known as Nahr Āshūr and Nahr-e Āshūr ) is a village in Jaffal Rural District in the Central District of Shadegan County Khuzestan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 675 in 106 families.
Kapalleki. Kapalleki is a village development committee in Doti District in the Seti Zone of western Nepal. At the time of the 2011 Nepal census it had a population of 4049.

Talkhi. Talkhi ( Persian: تلخي‎ also Romanized as Talkhī ) is a village in Zaveh Rural District in the Central District of Zaveh County Razavi Khorasan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 404 in 93 families.

Qaleh-ye Bala-ye Sian. Sar Nesa. Sar Nesa ( Persian: سرنسا‎ also Romanized as Sar Nesā’ and Sar Nasā’ ) is a village in Rud Ab-e Gharbi Rural District Rud Ab District Narmashir County Kerman Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 494 in 111 families.
Kyungon Banmauk. Kyungon is a village in Banmauk Township Katha District in the Sagaing Region of northern-central Burma.

Rowghan Garan. Rowghan Garan ( Persian: روغن گران‎ also Romanized as Rowghan Garān ) is a village in Miyan Velayat Rural District in the Central District of Mashhad County Razavi Khorasan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 21 in 4 families.

Taftafineh Shams Ali. Taftafineh Shams Ali ( Persian: تاف تافينه شمسعلي‎ also Romanized as Tāftāfīneh Shams ʿAlī; also known as Tāftāfīneh ) is a village in Teshkan Rural District Chegeni District Dowreh County Lorestan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 223 in 46 families.

Czysta Dębina. Czysta Dębina [ˈt͡ʂɨsta dɛmˈbʲina] ( Ukrainian: Чиста Дубина Chysta Dubyna ) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Gorzków within Krasnystaw County Lublin Voivodeship in eastern Poland.

Większyce. Większyce [vjɛnkˈʂɨt͡sɛ] ( German: Wiegschütz ) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Reńska Wieś within Kędzierzyn-Koźle County Opole Voivodeship in south-western Poland. Nahar Semnan. Nahar ( Persian: ناهر‎ also Romanized as Nāhar ) is a village in Kharturan Rural District Beyarjomand District Shahrud County Semnan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 53 in 16 families.
Jasenica Lug. Jasenica Lug ( Cyrillic: Јасеница Луг ) is a village in the municipality of Trebinje Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Rakvice. Rakvice is a village in Břeclav District South Moravian Region Czech Republic. It has a population of 2187 ( 2006 est. ) . There are a large vineyards near the village.

Wólka Lipsko County. Wólka [ˈvulka] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Lipsko within Lipsko County Masovian Voivodeship in east-central Poland.

Niwnice. Niwnice [nivˈnit͡sɛ] ( German: Neuland ) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Lwówek Śląski within Lwówek Śląski County Lower Silesian Voivodeship in south-western Poland. Cheshmeh-ye Ali Qalandarabad. Chenar Bon Nowshahr. Chenar Bon ( Persian: چناربن‎ also Romanized as Chenār Bon ) is a village in Zanus Rastaq Rural District Kojur District Nowshahr County Mazandaran Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 244 in 50 families.

Earnewâld. Earnewâld ( Dutch: Eernewoude ) is a small village in Tytsjerksteradiel in the province Friesland of the Netherlands and has around the 418 citizens ( 2008 ) . A windmill De Princehofmolen is maintained as a landscape feature.

Alparslan Kastamonu. Alparslan is a village in the District of Kastamonu Kastamonu Province Turkey.

Miedniewice Masovian Voivodeship. Miedniewice [mjɛdɲɛˈvit͡sɛ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Wiskitki within Żyrardów County Masovian Voivodeship in east-central Poland. Stara Kościelnica. Stara Kościelnica [ˈstara kɔɕt͡ɕelˈnit͡sa] ( German: Alt Münsterberg ) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Miłoradz within Malbork County Pomeranian Voivodeship in northern Poland.

Mazury Łódź Voivodeship. Mazury [maˈzurɨ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Bełchatów within Bełchatów County Łódź Voivodeship in central Poland. It lies approximately 5 kilometres ( 3 mi ) south-east of Bełchatów and 51 km ( 32 mi ) south of the regional capital Łódź.
Obuladevaracheruvu. Obula-devara-cheruvu is a village and a mandal in Anantapur district in the state of Andhra Pradesh in India.[1]State Bank of India has got a Branch here.

Valikan. Valikan ( Persian: وليكن‎ also Romanized as Valīkan ) is a village in Firuzjah Rural District Bandpey-ye Sharqi District Babol County Mazandaran Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 24 in 8 families.

Qaleh Kohneh Kani Shirin. Qaleh Kohneh ( Persian: قلعه كهنه‎ also Romanized as Qal‘eh Kohneh ) is a village in Kani Shirin Rural District Karaftu District Divandarreh County Kurdistan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 550 in 97 families.

Kalno. Kalno [ˈkalnɔ] ( German: Kallendorf ) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Żarów within Świdnica County Lower Silesian Voivodeship in south-western Poland. Milićevo Selo. Milićevo Selo is a village in the municipality of Požega western Serbia. According to the 2002 census the village has a population of 694 people.

Dörtler Çukurova. Dörtler is a village in the District of Karaisalı Adana Province Turkey.

Chrustowo Piła County. Chrustowo [xrusˈtɔvɔ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Ujście within Piła County Greater Poland Voivodeship in west-central Poland. Oshdalaq. Oshdalaq ( Persian: اشدلق‎; also known as Uchky ‘Uliya Ūshdelaq Ushtula and Uzhkyulya ) is a village in Goyjah Bel Rural District in the Central District of Ahar County East Azerbaijan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 29 in 9 families.
Kuruksoi. Kuruksoi is a village and jamoat in north-western Tajikistan. It is located in Mastchoh District in Sughd province. The jamoat has a total population of 2729.

Duża Cerkwica. Duża Cerkwica [ˈduʐa t͡sɛrkˈfit͡sa] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Kamień Krajeński within Sępólno County Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship in north-central Poland. Kiełcze-Kopki. Kiełcze-Kopki [ˈkʲɛu̯t͡ʂɛ ˈkɔpki] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Kolno within Kolno County Podlaskie Voivodeship in north-eastern Poland. Mohammadiyeh Tabas. Mohammadiyeh ( Persian: محمديه‎ also Romanized as Moḩammadīyeh ) is a village in Montazeriyeh Rural District in the Central District of Tabas County South Khorasan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 24 in 5 families.
Gökkiriş Köşk. Gökkiriş Köşk is a village in the District of Köşk Aydın Province Turkey. As of 2010 it had a population of 801 people.

Rytele Suche. Rytele Suche [rɨˈtɛlɛ ˈsuxɛ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Ceranów within Sokołów County Masovian Voivodeship in east-central Poland. Šeovica. Šeovica is a village in Croatia.

Qoturlar. Qoturlar ( Persian: قطورلار‎ also Romanized as Qoţūrlār ) is a village in Bakeshluchay Rural District in the Central District of Urmia County West Azerbaijan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 317 in 97 families.

Głębokie Lesser Poland Voivodeship. Gumdi. Gumdi is a village development committee in Dhading District in the Bagmati Zone of central Nepal. At the time of the 1991 Nepal census it had a population of 5091 and had 898 houses in it.

Zaviyeh-ye Kord. Tomisławice Łódź Voivodeship. Tomisławice [tɔmiswaˈvit͡sɛ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Warta within Sieradz County Łódź Voivodeship in central Poland. Arqih. Arqih ( Persian: ارقيه‎ also Romanized as Ārqīh and Arghāy ) is a village in Shahidabad Rural District Avaj District Buin Zahra County Qazvin Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 72 in 23 families.

Shoreyjeh-ye Yek. Shoreyjeh-ye Yek ( Persian: شريجه يك‎; also known as Mosherījeh and Moshirijeh ) is a village in Esmailiyeh Rural District in the Central District of Ahvaz County Khuzestan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its existence was noted but its population was not reported.

Zaki Alamdari. Zaki Alamdari ( Persian: ذكي علمداري‎ also Romanized as Ẕaḵī ʿAlmdārī ) is a village in Jam Rural District in the Central District of Jam County Bushehr Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 35 in 8 families.
Szentistvánbaksa. Szentistvánbaksa is a village in Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén County in northeastern Hungary.

Sütlüce Yusufeli. Sütlüce is a village in the District of Yusufeli Artvin Province Turkey. As of 2010 it had a population of 89 people.

Chahak South Khorasan. Chahak ( Persian: چاهك‎ also Romanized as Chāhak ) is a village in Afriz Rural District Sedeh District Qaen County South Khorasan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 1068 in 274 families.

Czarnowice. Czarnowice [t͡ʂarnɔˈvit͡sɛ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Gubin within Krosno Odrzańskie County Lubusz Voivodeship in western Poland close to the German border. Deh-e Aqa Saveh. Deh-e Aqa ( Persian: ده اقا‎ also Romanized as Deh-e Āqā and Deh Āqā; also known as Deh Sa‘īd ) is a village in Shahsavan Kandi Rural District in the Central District of Saveh County Markazi Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 28 in 14 families.
Esence Beşiri. Esence is a village in the District of Beşiri Batman Province Turkey. As of 2011 it had a population of 404 people.

Dar-e Zard. Dar-e Zard ( Persian: درزرد‎; also known as Dar-e Zar ) is a village in Toghrol Al Jerd Rural District Toghrol Al Jerd District Kuhbanan County Kerman Province Iran. At the 2006 census its existence was noted but its population was not reported.

Wygoda Łomża County. Wygoda [vɨˈɡɔda] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Łomża within Łomża County Podlaskie Voivodeship in north-eastern Poland. It lies approximately 12 kilometres ( 7 mi ) south of Łomża and 69 km ( 43 mi ) west of the regional capital Białystok.

Haratomeh. Haratomeh ( Persian: هراتمه‎ also Romanized as Harātomeh and Harātameh; also known as Hartuman ) is a village in Garkan Rural District Garkan-e Jonubi District Mobarakeh County Isfahan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 1335 in 360 families.

Chah Hasan Khani. Chah Hasan Khani ( Persian: چاه حسن خاني‎ also Romanized as Chāh Ḩasan Khānī ) is a village in Golestan Rural District in the Central District of Sirjan County Kerman Province Iran. At the 2006 census its existence was noted but its population was not reported.

Dedeler Göynük. Dedeler is a village in the District of Göynük Bolu Province Turkey. As of 2010 it had a population of 514 people.

Brygidów. Brygidów [brɨˈɡiduf] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Krasocin within Włoszczowa County Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship in south-central Poland. Shareh Khvor. Shareh Khvor ( Persian: شره خور‎ ) is a village in Bask-e Kuleseh Rural District in the Central District of Sardasht County West Azerbaijan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 14 in 4 families.

Borków Kielce County. Borków [ˈbɔrkuf] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Daleszyce within Kielce County Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship in south-central Poland. Studzieniec Sierpc County. Studzieniec [stuˈd͡ʑeɲet͡s] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Sierpc within Sierpc County Masovian Voivodeship in east-central Poland. It lies approximately 3 kilometres ( 2 mi ) south-west of Sierpc and 117 km ( 73 mi ) north-west of Warsaw.

Talmara. Talmara ( Persian: تل مرا‎ also Romanized as Tālmarā ) is a village in Ashkara Rural District Fareghan District Hajjiabad County Hormozgan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 47 in 14 families.

Jędrzychowice Zgorzelec County. Wangerberg. Wangerberg is a village of Liechtenstein in the municipality of Triesenberg located on a hill in front of Triesen.
Darodi. Darodi is a village in Parner taluka in Ahmednagar district of state of Maharashtra India.

Węgierka. Węgierka [vɛŋˈɡʲɛrka] ( Ukrainian: Угорка Uhorka ) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Roźwienica within Jarosław County Subcarpathian Voivodeship in south-eastern Poland. It lies approximately 17 kilometres ( 11 mi ) south-west of Jarosław and 42 km ( 26 mi ) east of the regional capital Rzeszów.The village has a population of 940.

Shaye Iran. Shaye ( Persian: شايع‎ also Romanized as Shāye‘; also known as Shāyeh ) is a village in Tabadkan Rural District in the Central District of Mashhad County Razavi Khorasan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 577 in 158 families.

Harain-e Olya. Harain-e Olya ( Persian: هرائين عليا‎ also Romanized as Harā’īn-e ‘Olyā Harā’īn Owlyā and Haraīyan Ūlīya; also known as Harā’īn and Harāyen ) is a village in Shahidabad Rural District Avaj District Buin Zahra County Qazvin Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 1112 in 277 families.

Darreh-ye Zereshk. Darreh-ye Zereshk ( Persian: دره زرشك‎ also Romanized as Darrehzereshk ) is a village in Dehshir Rural District in the Central District of Taft County Yazd Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 71 in 31 families.

Gusheh Daraq. Gusheh Daraq ( Persian: گوشه درق‎ also Romanized as Gūsheh Daraq; also known as Gūsheh Darreh Gūsheh Vazaq Koosheha Draq Shordar’ya Shordere Shū Darreh Shūr Daraq and Shūr Darreh ) is a village in Bonab Rural District in the Central District of Marand County East Azerbaijan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its existence was noted but its population was not reported.

Dust Beyglu. Dust Beyglu ( Persian: دوستبيگلو‎ also Romanized as Dūst Beyglū; also known as Dust‘ali Beyglū ) is a village in Dasht Rural District in the Central District of Meshgin Shahr County Ardabil Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 769 in 149 families.

Dobrá ( Frýdek-Místek District ) . Dobrá ( Polish: Dobra German: Dobrau ) is a village in the Frýdek-Místek District Moravian-Silesian Region of the Czech Republic. It has 2997 inhabitants ( 2006 ) . It lies on the Morávka River in the historical region of Těšín Silesia. The village is nowadays known for the big Hyundai factory which has been being built in Nošovice a village nearby.
Holliday Missouri. Holliday is a village in Monroe County Missouri United States. The population was 137 at the 2010 census.

Żaba Opole Voivodeship. Żaba [ˈʐaba] ( German Saabe ) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Namysłów within Namysłów County Opole Voivodeship in south-western Poland. It lies approximately 10 kilometres ( 6 mi ) south of Namysłów and 41 km ( 25 mi ) north-west of the regional capital Opole.Before 1945 the area was part of Germany ( see Territorial changes of Poland after World War II ) .

Żurawiec Lublin Voivodeship. Żurawiec [ʐuˈravjɛt͡s] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Adamów within Łuków County Lublin Voivodeship in eastern Poland. It lies approximately 9 kilometres ( 6 mi ) south-west of Adamów 30 km ( 19 mi ) south-west of Łuków and 56 km ( 35 mi ) north-west of the regional capital Lublin.The village has a population of 320.

Ramche Sindhulpalchok. Ramche is a village in Sindhupalchok District in the Bagmati Zone of central Nepal. At the time of the 1991 Nepal census it had a population of 2893 and had 566 houses in the village.

Sarab Sarayan. Sarab ( Persian: سراب‎ also Romanized as Sarāb ) is a village in Ayask Rural District in the Central District of Sarayan County South Khorasan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 134 in 38 families.
Pod Bubnowem. Pod Bubnowem [ˈpɔt bubˈnɔvɛm] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Urszulin within Włodawa County Lublin Voivodeship in eastern Poland.
K.V.B.Puram. K.V.B.Puram is a village and a Mandal in Chittoor district in the state of Andhra Pradesh in India.

Rum Dasht. Rum Dasht ( Persian: روم دشت‎ also Romanized as Rūm Dasht ) is a village in Shuil Rural District Rahimabad District Rudsar County Gilan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 98 in 37 families.

Sątyrz Pierwszy. Sątyrz Pierwszy [ˈsɔntɨʂ ˈpjɛrfʂɨ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Chociwel within Stargard County West Pomeranian Voivodeship in north-western Poland. It lies approximately 8 kilometres ( 5 mi ) east of Chociwel 32 km ( 20 mi ) north-east of Stargard Szczeciński and 58 km ( 36 mi ) east of the regional capital Szczecin.Before 1945 the area was part of Germany. For the history of the region see History of Pomerania.The village has a population of 27.

Hollum. Hollum is a Dutch village on Ameland one of the West Frisian Islands. It is situated on the westernmost part of the island.Prominent in the town is a Reformed church with foundations from the 12th century and a lighthouse which is 59 m high dating from 1880. Also a notable feature are the Commandeur huuskes.

Shamusilabi. Shamusilabi ( Persian: شموسيلابي‎ also Romanized as Shamūsīlābī; also known as Shams ʿAlī Kandī and Shamū Salāvī ) is a village in Qarah Quyun-e Jonubi Rural District Qarah Quyun District Showt County West Azerbaijan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 201 in 55 families.
Karacalar Emirdağ. Karacalar is a village in the District of Emirdağ Afyonkarahisar Province Turkey.

Kościernica Koszalin County. Kościernica [kɔɕt͡ɕerˈnit͡sa] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Polanów within Koszalin County West Pomeranian Voivodeship in north-western Poland. It lies approximately 19 kilometres ( 12 mi ) west of Polanów 18 km ( 11 mi ) east of Koszalin and 148 km ( 92 mi ) north-east of the regional capital Szczecin.Before 1945 the area was part of Germany. For the history of the region see History of Pomerania.The village has a population of 284.

Mowtowr-e Ab Rostam Abir. Mowtowr-e Ab Rostam Abir ( Persian: موتور آب رستم ابير‎ also Romanized as Mowtowr-e Āb Rostam Ābīr ) is a village in Pir Sohrab Rural District in the Central District of Chabahar County Sistan and Baluchestan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 19 in 4 families.

Uch Tappeh Kabudarahang. Uch Tappeh ( Persian: اوچ تپه‎ also Romanized as Ūch Tappeh and Owch Tappeh ) is a village in Sardaran Rural District in the Central District of Kabudarahang County Hamadan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 55 in 12 families.
Hudovo. Hudovo is a village in Croatia.

Borówek Łódź Voivodeship. Borówek [bɔˈruvɛk] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Bielawy within Łowicz County Łódź Voivodeship in central Poland. It lies approximately 6 kilometres ( 4 mi ) north-west of Bielawy 23 km ( 14 mi ) west of Łowicz and 37 km ( 23 mi ) north of the regional capital Łódź.
Adrasan Kumluca. Adrasan is a village in the District of Kumluca Antalya Province Turkey.
Kuzmičevo. Kuzmičevo is a village situated in Novi Pazar municipality in Serbia.

Sahamabad. Sahamabad ( Persian: سهام اباد‎ also Romanized as Sahāmābād ) is a village in Hayaquq-e Nabi Rural District in the Central District of Tuyserkan County Hamadan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 315 in 92 families.

Zawały Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship. Zawały [zaˈvawɨ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Obrowo within Toruń County Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship in north-central Poland. It lies approximately 4 kilometres ( 2 mi ) north-west of Obrowo and 16 km ( 10 mi ) east of Toruń.

Lorun. Lorun ( Persian: لرون‎ also Romanized as Lorūn; also known as Looroon Lowrūn Lūrūn and Owrūn ) is a village in Dowlatabad Rural District in the Central District of Namin County Ardabil Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 127 in 31 families.
Kosów Ruski. Kosów Ruski [ˈkɔsuf ˈruski] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Kosów Lacki within Sokołów County Masovian Voivodeship in east-central Poland.

Janiszewo Pomeranian Voivodeship. Janiszewo [janiˈʂɛvɔ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Pelplin within Tczew County Pomeranian Voivodeship in northern Poland. It lies approximately 5 kilometres ( 3 mi ) south of Pelplin 24 km ( 15 mi ) south of Tczew and 54 km ( 34 mi ) south of the regional capital Gdańsk.For details of the history of the region see History of Pomerania.The village has a population of 266.

Dzierzków. Dzierzków [ˈd͡ʑeʂkuf] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Dobromierz within Świdnica County Lower Silesian Voivodeship in south-western Poland. Prior to 1945 it was in Germany.It lies approximately 9 kilometres ( 6 mi ) north of Dobromierz 21 kilometres ( 13 mi ) north-west of Świdnica and 59 kilometres ( 37 mi ) west of the regional capital Wrocław.

Kuik-e Azizi Amin. Kuik-e Azizi Amin ( Persian: كوئيك عزيزي امين‎ also Romanized as Kū’īk-e ‘Azīzī Amīn; also known as Kū’īk-e ‘Azīz and Kūyakī-ye ‘Azīz ) is a village in Dasht-e Zahab Rural District in the Central District of Sarpol-e Zahab County Kermanshah Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 639 in 121 families.
Bunčići. Bunčići is a village in the municipality of Foča Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Borek Gołdap County. Borek [ˈbɔrɛk] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Banie Mazurskie within Gołdap County Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship in northern Poland close to the border with the Kaliningrad Oblast of Russia. It lies approximately 9 kilometres ( 6 mi ) south-east of Banie Mazurskie 17 km ( 11 mi ) south-west of Gołdap and 118 km ( 73 mi ) north-east of the regional capital Olsztyn.Before 1945 the area was part of Germany ( East Prussia ) .

Anjilan Gilan. Anjilan ( Persian: انجيلان‎ also Romanized as Anjīlān ) is a village in Shanderman Rural District Shanderman District Masal County Gilan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 208 in 53 families.

Narmeh. Narmeh ( Persian: نرمه‎; also known as Narmeh Sa‘dābād and Narmeh-ye Pa’īn ) is a village in Vardasht Rural District in the Central District of Semirom County Isfahan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 113 in 27 families.

Seyyed Nezam ol Din. Seyyed Nezam ol Din ( Persian: سيدنظام الدين‎ also Romanized as Seyyed Nez̧ām ol Dīn Seyyed Nez̧ām ed Dīn and Seyyed Nez̧ām od Dīn ) is a village in Sajjadrud Rural District Bandpey-ye Sharqi District Babol County Mazandaran Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 1033 in 267 families.

Kacice Masovian Voivodeship. Kacice [kaˈt͡ɕit͡sɛ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Pułtusk within Pułtusk County Masovian Voivodeship in east-central Poland. It lies approximately 4 kilometres ( 2 mi ) south of Pułtusk and 51 km ( 32 mi ) north of Warsaw.

Bierzwienna Długa-Kolonia. Bierzwienna Długa-Kolonia [bjɛʐˈvjɛnna ˈdwuɡa kɔˈlɔɲa] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Kłodawa within Koło County Greater Poland Voivodeship in west-central Poland.The village has a population of 400.

Hasan Shahab. Hasan Shahab ( Persian: حسن شهاب‎ also Romanized as Ḩasan Shahāb; also known as Ḩasan Shoqā and Ḩasan Shaqāb ) is a village in Tabadkan Rural District in the Central District of Mashhad County Razavi Khorasan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 98 in 22 families.

Rewica-Kolonia. Rewica-Kolonia [rɛˈvit͡sa kɔˈlɔɲa] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Jeżów within Brzeziny County Łódź Voivodeship in central Poland. It lies approximately 10 kilometres ( 6 mi ) south of Jeżów 14 km ( 9 mi ) south-east of Brzeziny and 32 km ( 20 mi ) east of the regional capital Łódź.
Suwâld. Suwâld ( Dutch: Suawoude ) is a small village in Tytsjerksteradiel in the province Friesland of the Netherlands and has around 651 citizens ( 2008 ) .
Küçükdikili Seyhan. Küçükdikili is a village in the District of Seyhan Adana Province Turkey.
Kangani Anjouan. Kangani is a village on the island of Anjouan in the Comoros. According to the 1991 census the town had a population of 2308. The current calculation for 2012 is 4416 people

Krężel Gryfice County. Krężel [ˈkrɛ̃ʐɛl] ( German: Henkenheide ) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Płoty within Gryfice County West Pomeranian Voivodeship in north-western Poland.Before 1945 the area was part of Germany. For the history of the region see History of Pomerania.
Väljataguse Rapla County. Väljataguse is a village in Rapla Parish Rapla County Estonia.

Chah Sabz Bavanat. Chah Sabz ( Persian: چاه سبز‎ also Romanized as Chāh Sabz ) is a village in Tujerdi Rural District Sarchehan District Bavanat County Fars Province Iran. At the 2006 census its existence was noted but its population was not reported.

Amanabad North Khorasan. Amanabad ( Persian: امان اباد‎ also Romanized as Amānābād ) is a village in Ziarat Rural District in the Central District of Shirvan County North Khorasan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 124 in 28 families.

Guri Khuzestan. Guri ( Persian: گوري‎ also Romanized as Gūrī ) is a village in Tolbozan Rural District Golgir District Masjed Soleyman County Khuzestan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 106 in 17 families.

Żygląd. Żygląd [ˈʐɨɡlɔnt] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Papowo Biskupie within Chełmno County Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship in north-central Poland. It lies 4 kilometres ( 2 mi ) west of Papowo Biskupie 15 km ( 9 mi ) south-east of Chełmno 25 km ( 16 mi ) north of Toruń and 38 km ( 24 mi ) north-east of Bydgoszcz.

Kalateh-ye Baluch Darmian. Kalateh-ye Baluch ( Persian: كلاته بلوچ‎ also Romanized as Kalāteh-ye Balūch and Kalateh Balooch; also known as Kalāt-e Balūch and Kalāteh-ye Rokh ) is a village in Gazik Rural District Gazik District Darmian County South Khorasan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 53 in 11 families.

Bratuszewo. Bratuszewo [bratuˈʂɛvɔ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Kurzętnik within Nowe Miasto County Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship in northern Poland. It lies approximately 6 kilometres ( 4 mi ) south of Nowe Miasto Lubawskie and 75 km ( 47 mi ) south-west of the regional capital Olsztyn.
Kamenica ( Gornji Milanovac ) . Kamenica is a village in the municipality of Gornji Milanovac Serbia. According to the 2002 census the village has a population of 37 people.

Mazraeh-ye Sefidan. Mazraeh-ye Sefidan ( Persian: مزرعه سفيدان‎ also Romanized as Mazra‘eh-ye Sefīdān ) is a village in Rabatat Rural District Kharanaq District Ardakan County Yazd Province Iran. At the 2006 census its existence was noted but its population was not reported.

Azad Veys-e Sofla. Azad Veys-e Sofla ( Persian: آزاد ويس سفلي‎ also Romanized as Āzād Veys-e Soflá; also known as Āzād Veys-e Pā’īn ) is a village in Korani Rural District Korani District Bijar County Kurdistan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 60 in 15 families.

Osiny Częstochowa County. Osiny [ɔˈɕinɨ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Kamienica Polska within Częstochowa County Silesian Voivodeship in southern Poland. It lies approximately 14 kilometres ( 9 mi ) south of Częstochowa and 50 km ( 31 mi ) north of the regional capital Katowice.The village has a population of 799.

Mikłusy. Mikłusy [miˈkwusɨ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Trzebieszów within Łuków County Lublin Voivodeship in eastern Poland. It lies approximately 9 kilometres ( 6 mi ) north-west of Trzebieszów 17 km ( 11 mi ) north-east of Łuków and 90 km ( 56 mi ) north of the regional capital Lublin.

Stodolsko. Stodolsko [stɔˈdɔlskɔ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Rakoniewice within Grodzisk Wielkopolski County Greater Poland Voivodeship in west-central Poland. It lies approximately 4 kilometres ( 2 mi ) west of Rakoniewice 14 km ( 9 mi ) south-west of Grodzisk Wielkopolski and 56 km ( 35 mi ) south-west of the regional capital Poznań.

Amirabad Kaleybar. Amirabad ( Persian: اميراباد‎ also Romanized as Amīrābād ) is a village in Abish Ahmad Rural District Abish Ahmad District Kaleybar County East Azerbaijan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 535 in 104 families.

Geliyan Kurdistan. Geliyan ( Persian: گليان‎ also Romanized as Gelīyān and Gelyān ) is a village in Zhavehrud Rural District in the Central District of Kamyaran County Kurdistan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 254 in 60 families.

Śmieciuchówka. Śmieciuchówka [ɕmjɛt͡ɕuˈxufka] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Przerośl within Suwałki County Podlaskie Voivodeship in north-eastern Poland. It lies approximately 10 kilometres ( 6 mi ) south-east of Przerośl 17 km ( 11 mi ) north-west of Suwałki and 124 km ( 77 mi ) north of the regional capital Białystok.

Wężewo Masovian Voivodeship. Wężewo [vɛ̃ˈʐɛvɔ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Krasne within Przasnysz County Masovian Voivodeship in east-central Poland. It lies approximately 12 kilometres ( 7 mi ) south of Przasnysz and 78 km ( 48 mi ) north of Warsaw.The village has a population of 300.

Tusvik. Tusvik or Tusvika is a small village in Sykkylven Municipality in Møre og Romsdal county Norway. It is located along the Storfjorden about 4 kilometres ( 2.5 mi ) west of the village of Ikornnes and 4 kilometres ( 2.5 mi ) west of the municipal center Aure ( via the Sykkylven Bridge over the Sykkylvsfjorden ) .Tusvik lies in Sykkylven Municipality which is primarily an industrial area with large industries such as RAJO Ekornes and LK Hjelle Møbelfabrikk based here.

Dehdaran-e Sofla. Dehdaran-e Sofla ( Persian: دهداران سفلي‎ also Romanized as Dehdārān-e Soflá and Dehdaran Sofla; also known as Dehdārān and Dehdārān-e Pā’īn ) is a village in Shabankareh Rural District Shabankareh District Dashtestan County Bushehr Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 1767 in 350 families.
Tarva Halinga Parish. Tarva Halinga Parish is a village in Halinga Parish Pärnu County in southwestern Estonia.

Rączki Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship. Rączki [ˈrɔnt͡ʂki] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Nidzica within Nidzica County Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship in northern Poland. It lies approximately 9 kilometres ( 6 mi ) north-west of Nidzica and 44 km ( 27 mi ) south of the regional capital Olsztyn.The village has a population of 240.

Dowyran. Dowyran ( Persian: دويران‎ also Romanized as Dowyrān; also known as Doyrān ) is a village in Nazlu-e Shomali Rural District Nazlu District Urmia County West Azerbaijan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 348 in 92 families.

Tahtali. Tahtali ( Persian: تحتالي‎ also Romanized as Taḥtālī ) is a village in Jazmurian Rural District Jazmurian District Rudbar-e Jonubi County Kerman Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 168 in 39 families.

Imir Ardabil. Imir ( Persian: ايمير‎ also Romanized as Īmīr ) is a village in Arshaq Sharqi Rural District in the Central District of Ardabil County Ardabil Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 90 in 15 families.

Langar-e Qadim. Langar-e Qadim ( Persian: لنگرقديم‎ also Romanized as Langar-e Qadīm ) is a village in Miyan Ab-e Shomali Rural District in the Central District of Shushtar County Khuzestan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 271 in 53 families.

Badepalli Karnataka. Badepalli is a village in the southern state of Karnataka India. Administratively Badepalli is under Ajlapur gram panchayat Yadgir Taluka of Yadgir District in Karnataka. Badepalli is 10 km by road south of the village of Madhawar and 14 km by road east of the town of Saidapur where Narayanpet Road Station is the nearest railway station.

Ruzrak. Ruzrak ( Persian: روزرك‎ also Romanized as Rūzrak and Rūzarak ) is a village in Howmeh-ye Sharqi Rural District in the Central District of Izeh County Khuzestan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 80 in 14 families.

Somaqlu. Somaqlu ( Persian: سماقلو‎ also Romanized as Somāqlū; also known as Esmāqlū and Somāghlū ) is a village in Zu ol Faqr Rural District Sarshiv District Saqqez County Kurdistan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 393 in 73 families.
Duninopol. Duninopol [duniˈnɔpɔl] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Wiskitki within Żyrardów County Masovian Voivodeship in east-central Poland.
Dub ( Rogatica ) . Dub ( Serbian: Дуб ) is a village in the Republika Srpska Bosnia and Herzegovina. According to the 1991 census the village is located in the municipality of Rogatica.

Sustan. Sustan ( Persian: سوستان‎ also Romanized as Sūstān; also known as Sīstān ) is a village in Layl Rural District in the Central District of Lahijan County Gilan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 4341 in 1229 families.

Narges Koti Babol. Narges Koti ( Persian: نرگس كتي‎ also Romanized as Narges Kotī; also known as Nargesī Kotī ) is a village in Sajjadrud Rural District Bandpey-ye Sharqi District Babol County Mazandaran Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 101 in 28 families.
Ududeniya Sinhalagama. Ududeniya Sinhalagama is a village in Sri Lanka. It is located within Central Province.
Prisoje ( Goražde ) . Prisoje ( Goražde ) is a village in the municipality of Goražde Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Deh Sefid Karim. Deh Sefid Karim ( Persian: ده سفيدكريم‎ also Romanized as Deh Sefīd Karīm; also known as Deh Sefīd ) is a village in Kakasharaf Rural District in the Central District of Khorramabad County Lorestan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 70 in 13 families.

Raiyyat Mahalleh. Raiyyat Mahalleh ( Persian: رعيت محله‎ also Romanized as Ra‘īyyat Maḩalleh ) is a village in Rudboneh Rural District Rudboneh District Lahijan County Gilan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 321 in 87 families.
Bondo Mali. Bondo is a village and commune and seat of the Cercle of Koro in the Mopti Region of Mali. As of 1998 the commune had a population of 15872

Berlevåg ( village ) . Berlevåg is the administrative centre of Berlevåg Municipality in Finnmark county Norway. The village is located on the northeastern coast of the Varanger Peninsula along the Barents Sea. The village lies along Norwegian County Road 890 just east of Berlevåg Airport. The Hurtigruten coastal express boats stop daily at Berlevåg.

Liseh Rud-e Tazehabad. Liseh Rud-e Tazehabad ( Persian: ليسه رودتازه اباد‎ also Romanized as Līseh Rūd-e Tāzehābād ) is a village in Otaqvar Rural District Otaqvar District Langarud County Gilan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 400 in 106 families.

Masha-ye Ashayiri Shomareh-ye Yek. Masha-ye Ashayiri Shomareh-ye Yek ( Persian: مشاع عشايري شماره 1‎ also Romanized as Mashāʿ-ye ʿAshāyīrī Shomāreh-ye Yek ) is a village in Dowlatabad Rural District in the Central District of Jiroft County Kerman Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 27 in 5 families.
Ridaküla Rapla County. Ridaküla is a village in Rapla Parish Rapla County in northwestern Estonia.

Shivan Kandi. Shivan Kandi ( Persian: شيوان كندي‎ also Romanized as Shīvān Kandī; also known as Shīvā Kandī ) is a village in Firuraq Rural District in the Central District of Khoy County West Azerbaijan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 289 in 48 families.

Dysiek. Dysiek [ˈdɨɕek] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Trzemeszno within Gniezno County Greater Poland Voivodeship in west-central Poland. It lies approximately 9 kilometres ( 6 mi ) east of Trzemeszno 23 km ( 14 mi ) east of Gniezno and 71 km ( 44 mi ) east of the regional capital Poznań.

Klępie Górne. Klępie Górne [ˈklɛmpjɛ ˈɡurnɛ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Stopnica within Busko County Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship in south-central Poland. It lies approximately 5 kilometres ( 3 mi ) south-east of Stopnica 21 km ( 13 mi ) east of Busko-Zdrój and 59 km ( 37 mi ) south-east of the regional capital Kielce.The village has an approximate population of 340.

Cobleskill ( village ) New York. Cobleskill is a village in the western part of the town of Cobleskill in Schoharie County New York USA. The population was 4533 at the 2000 census.The village is southwest of Amsterdam. The State University of New York at Cobleskill is located at the western side of the village.

Mowtowr-e Darvish Huti ( 1 ) Dalgan. Mowtowr-e Darvish Huti ( Persian: موتور درويش هوتي‎ also Romanized as Mowtowr-e Darvīsh Hūtī ) is a village in Jolgeh-ye Chah Hashem Rural District Jolgeh-ye Chah Hashem District Dalgan County Sistan and Baluchestan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its existence was noted but its population was not reported.

Deh Now-e Kukhdan. Deh Now-e Kukhdan ( Persian: دهنوكوخدان‎ also Romanized as Deh Now-e Kūkhdān; also known as Deh Now ) is a village in Dana Rural District in the Central District of Dana County Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 145 in 29 families.
Vängla. Vängla is a village in Vigala Parish Rapla County in western Estonia.

Alakin. Alakin ( Persian: الاكين‎ also Romanized as Ālākīn ) is a village in Charuymaq-e Jonubesharqi Rural District Shadian District Charuymaq County East Azerbaijan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 140 in 24 families.

Dowbaneh Fars. Dowbaneh ( Persian: دوبنه‎ also Romanized as Do Baneh; also known as Donbeh Downbeh and Dunheh ) is a village in Maharlu Rural District Kuhenjan District Sarvestan County Fars Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 120 in 28 families.

Derazan. Derazan ( Persian: درازان‎ also Romanized as Derāzān ) is a village in Bala Khiyaban-e Litkuh Rural District in the Central District of Amol County Mazandaran Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 1211 in 338 families.
Grabanów-Kolonia. Grabanów-Kolonia [ɡraˈbanuf kɔˈlɔɲa] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Biała Podlaska within Biała Podlaska County Lublin Voivodeship in eastern Poland.

Dam Tang-e Sarna. Baluchi Fars. Baluchi ( Persian: بلوچي‎ also Romanized as Balūchī ) is a village in Darz and Sayeban Rural District in the Central District of Larestan County Fars Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 200 in 43 families.

Napalpí. Napalpí is a village and municipality in Chaco Province in northern Argentina.

Poźrzadło Wielkie. Sušica ( Kruševac ) . Sušica is a village in the municipality of Kruševac Serbia. According to the 2002 census the village has a population of 878 people.

Kabud Khani-ye Sofla. Niwnica. Niwnica [nivˈnit͡sa] ( German Neunz ) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Nysa within Nysa County Opole Voivodeship in south-western Poland. Plaster Rock New Brunswick. Plaster Rock ( 2011 population: 1135 ) is a Canadian village in Victoria County New Brunswick. The mayor is Alexis Fenner.

Küplüce Şavşat. Küplüce is a village in the District of Şavşat Artvin Province Turkey. As of 2011 it had a population of 154 people.

Qeshlaq-e Qaleh Now-e Amlak. Lähtse Lääne-Viru County. Lähtse is a village in Vinni Parish Lääne-Viru County in northeastern Estonia.

Kumteng. Kumteng is a village in Hkamti Township in Hkamti District in the Sagaing Region of northwestern Burma.

Tektaka. Tektaka is a village and rural commune in Mauritania.

Urszulin Włodawa County. Urszulin [urˈʂulin] is a village in Włodawa County Lublin Voivodeship in eastern Poland. It is the seat of the gmina ( administrative district ) called Gmina Urszulin. Rahjerd Hamadan. Rahjerd ( Persian: راهجرد‎ also Romanized as Rāhjerd; also known as Rājerd and Rājird ) is a village in Shur Dasht Rural District Shara District Hamadan County Hamadan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 512 in 102 families.

Pashagh-e Jadid. Pashagh-e Jadid ( Persian: پاشغ جديد‎ also Romanized as Pāshagh-e Jadīd; also known as Pāshagh ) is a village in Ahmadi Rural District Ahmadi District Hajjiabad County Hormozgan Province Iran. At the 2006 census its population was 534 in 119 families.

Debipur Bangladesh. Debipur is a village in Barisal District in the Barisal Division of southern-central Bangladesh.

Kovači ( Kraljevo ) . Kovači is a village situated in Kraljevo municipality in Serbia. Its population is 1297 according to the 2002 Census in Serbia.
Krępkowo Greater Poland Voivodeship. Krępkowo [krɛmpˈkɔvɔ] is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Strzałkowo within Słupca County Greater Poland Voivodeship in west-central Poland.

Somapur. Somapur is a village in Belgaum district in the southwestern state of Karnataka India.
